# Village Concept Bar

Village Concept Bar is a nightlife and events venue in São José, Santa Catarina, Brazil.

Address: Rua Domingos André Zanini, 277 — Barreiros — São José/SC.
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/villageconceptbar/
Official ticket and guest-list platform: https://www.pensanoevento.com.br/locais/111/village-concept-bar

The official website centralizes event agenda, ticket links, guest lists, reservations, celebration inquiries, location and contact information.

Event pages are available under /eventos/[slug] and link to the official external checkout when tickets are available.
